newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive says 97 pct accepted Vivra bid.
newsitem.headline: Incentive says 97 pct accepted Vivra bid.

text.p: Swedish investment company Incentive said on Monday that its bid for U.S. dialysis clinic company Vivra had been accepted by 97 percent of the shareholders.
"Accordingly, Vivra becomes a wholly owned subsidiary within the Incentive group," Incentive said in a statement.
Vivra's dialysis clinic operations, Vivra Renal Care, has about 260 clinics, 16,000 patients and 1996 sales of $411 million.
It will be integrated into the U.S. dialysis clinic operations of Gambro, a wholly owned unit of Incentive.
"Ths company strengthens (Gambro's) leading position in the American market and will have about 26,000 patients in some 370 clinics," the statement said.
Vivra's operations within other specialised health-care, Vivra Speciality Partners, was divested, Incentive said.
Incentive shares were four crowns higher at 690 crowns at 0840 GMT.
